limitations: ChatGPT product-level personal memory is not exposed as a controllable Codex CLI input, so no claim is made for proprietary assistant-memory injection.
The requested Google/Gemini E4B route is physically the exact Google Gemma 4 E4B local artifact; Gemini was not silently substituted.
MSI account profiles are reachable but currently authentication-blocked; no MSI model-transition cell is claimed.
